props.name: segments
props.description: Points in the rope. More is heavier and smoother.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Downward pull per frame. 0 makes it a weightless ribbon.

props.name: damping
props.description: Velocity kept each frame. Lower is more damped.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Constraint passes. More is stiffer and less stretchy.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the rope.

props.name: taper
props.description: Thickest at the pointer, tapering to nothing at the tail.
